items.title: China agrees to buy 10 million tons of U.S. coal in 2027 and 2028
items.summary: Investing.com -- China has agreed to purchase at least 10 million metric tons of U.S. coal in both 2027 and 2028 as Washington and Beijing expand trade cooperation following their latest high-level talks, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: Can Share Buybacks Continue to Prop Up Toro Stock?
items.summary: Toro (TTC) trades within about 4% of its 52-week high, and it keeps buying back shares with cash from zero-turn mowers, golf equipment and Ditch Witch drills. But over three years the buybacks have only softened a fall in earnings per share, and today's price assumes profit growth comes back.

items.title: Atlas Energy Solutions Stock Surges on Power Deal With ‘Leading Frontier AI Lab’
items.summary: An artificial intelligence firm is financially backing part of  Atlas Energy Solutions  ’ data-center power buildout, Atlas announced Friday.  Shares of Atlas surged 17% to $12.85, pacing toward their largest increase since Oct. 29, 2025, and they briefly traded at a record pace of 21% earlier in the session, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  Atlas said it reached two cost-reimbursement agreements with the AI lab to purchase equipment and power generation capabilities for data center projects.
